invariants: Cross-drive glob and grep must retain usable absolute Windows result paths.
open_questions: Review rc.1 provider/consumer changes and obtain new acceptance; alpha observations cannot certify this revision.
identity: Same-volume results remain workdir-relative; different-drive/UNC-volume results retain absolute identity.
ownership: Search owns path formatting; no global cwd mutation.
ordering: Format after search without altering match ordering.
errors: Catch only relpath ValueError for incompatible roots; other errors propagate.
cancellation: No added tasks or cancellation behavior; search lifecycle unchanged.
adaptation: Python ntpath.relpath raises across drives where Node path.win32.relative returns an absolute path; retain the input path.

rc1_review.scope: The revised executable corpus and current Source inputs define bounded acceptance; historical alpha reviews remain historical.
